Which of the following reflections is absent in a Body-Centered Cubic (BCC) lattice?
explanation: For BCC, h + k + l must be even. For (2 2 1), the sum is 2 + 2 + 1 = 5 (odd), so it is absent.

For a Face-Centered Cubic (FCC) lattice, which set of Miller indices represents an allowed reflection?
explanation: In an FCC lattice, allowed reflections require all Miller indices to be either all odd or all even. (2 2 2) has all even indices.
